# Headless Kimchi workflows

> **Last verified:** 2026-10-04 — Kimchi-only opt-in delivery, required child
> model, read-only record reading, and a lockfile version gate for the jq fold.

`ai.programs.kimchi-workflow.enable = true` opts into the Kimchi-only skill on
both backends, with `ai.kimchi.programs.kimchi-workflow.enable` as its nullable
runtime override. The existing skill-package helper delivers `SKILL.md` plus one
`bin` store link through the native skill roots. The private `mkWorkflowSkill`
helper bundles the launcher; neither helper depends on the Kimchi package: the
launcher resolves the operator's configured `kimchi` on PATH.

`kimchi-workflow-run --model ID [--input JSON|@FILE] FILE.workflow.ts` resolves
the workflow to an absolute path, appends `extensions.workflows` to the existing
environment list, retains the real HOME/XDG, and launches a separate JSON-mode
child with `--thinking off`, closed stdin and a fresh empty session directory.
The caller must set the bash timeout explicitly. First use prepares the upstream
project package with corepack/pnpm and may need network. Persistent resource
disable settings can override environment enablement. No `workflowsSource`
passthru exists at this revision, so the skill points at the upstream package's
project-installed README, docs and examples.

`--read-session DIR [CHILD_EXIT_CODE]` reads a stopped child's saved evidence
without launching a model. Exactly one `workflow/*.events.jsonl` is required.
JSON contains `runId`, `status`, `output` or `error`, `sessionDir`,
`eventsFile`; only completed exits zero. Missing records report the child exit
and stderr tail; multiple records are ambiguous. Invalid JSON, missing
run-started and mixed IDs fail. Unfinished work remains `in_progress` with an
abandoned-work error and a nonzero exit. Blocked results include all pending
questionnaire/interaction payloads and their dynamic paths, excluding opaque
`conversation` history.

The jq fold mirrors `@kimchi-dev/kimchi-workflows@0.0.9`
`src/engine/run-status.ts`, `step-state.ts` and `node-path.ts`: active steps
precede blocked steps, then the latest run terminal event decides; crash/cancel
closes open steps. Loop indices collapse but foreach item indices remain
distinct. `checks/workflow-run.nix` checks copied probe records without Kimchi
or models, plus synthetic cancellation, abandonment and malformed records. See
the fixture README for exact evidence. The 2026-10-04 probe used Kimchi 1.5.1,
model `kimchi-dev/glm-5.3-flash`, the real home, and a `kimchi -p` parent
session launching through bash; `run-completed` was observed. Interactive
availability remains unverified. `kimchi-workflow-version` reads the build's
pinned `pnpm-lock.yaml` at check-build time and rejects bundled versions other
than 0.0.9 until this fold is verified again; evaluation stays IFD-free.

`workflow-skill.nix` checks opt-in, both backends, Kimchi-only scope, runtime
overrides and the `bin` link. The routing row follows the resolved skill enable
and covers only the measured headless mode.
